rounds.rationale: Select these 15 roles for source-grounded proposals and review, not as a ranked implementation queue. a_transpose studies conversion work in Llibxsmm_78; panel_packing owns complete producer/consumer layout changes; cache_blocking studies working-set sizes; loop_order coordinates traversal at Llibxsmm_64 and Llibxsmm_440. b_panel_layout examines timed packing of B, while transpose_fusion examines feeding compute without a full scratch write. These are separate questions, not automatically distinct experiments. vector_access reviews packing and output stores; address_generation checks pointer advances and rewinds; tail_alignment protects bounds, general sizes and n<=0. scratch_lifetime examines keeping scratch allocated through its consumers, classified as an ABI repair rather than an established speed improvement. streaming_region_cost reviews legal SME boundaries; assembly_audit checks supplied assembly, register obligations and coordinated edits without claiming unseen compiler evidence. za_four_tile_reuse examines mappings within ZA0–ZA3. prefetch_locality considers bounded access hints with their overhead included. k_loop_schedule examines only a distinct reduction-control change, such as a fixed 256-iteration two-K loop without the prior tail logic; the two-bank schedule itself is already tested. Exclude duplicate measured schedules, sixteen-panel wrappers, constant-shape C/SME and 272-byte padding. New generated helpers are unavailable and cannot be current implementation dependencies.
